events.title: Steam Next Fest starts today, and the updated DARK RAIL demo is ready for you!
events.summary: To everyone who played the demo and told me what you thought: thank you. I've listened to your feedback on the balancing and made adjustments for this new version. Alongside those changes, I've given the demo another substantial round of polish.If you've played before, I'd love for you to start a fresh run and tell me how it feels now. events.title: THE DARK RAIL DEMO IS OUT NOW
events.summary: The DARK RAIL demo is now available to play on Steam.DARK RAIL is a turn-based management roguelike set in a brutal industrial city at the edge of a crumbling empire. Beyond its walls, ancient creatures stir, corrupted forests spread, and heretical cults gather in places the empire has long abandoned.You have been sent to restore order.Command the Inquisition from your armoured train and take control of the city’s remaining institutions.
